2.12.9 Image.Height
The Image.Height element specifies the height of an Image. This element is optional. If this element
is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as the
height of the image's container, such as a Rectangle or Body, minus the value of the Image.Top
element, if specified.
Following is the parent element of the Image.Height element.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.Height element.
 <xsd:element name="Height" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
